mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60d returns in more than 70% of quarters where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20d returns in more than 50% of triggered periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise of at least 1% in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) within the same month indicates a broad-based expansion in supply capacity, which typically precedes positive earnings revisions and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both rise > 1% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are not statistically different from zero in more than 70% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase of over 0.5 percentage points in the unemployment rate, accompanied by a concurrent decline of over 1% in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), signals a sudden labor market shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND PAYEMS falls > 1% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5d returns in more than 50% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) for four consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which is associated with lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate held below 2% for more than six consecutive months in a low-inflation environment signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports risk asset valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns are not significantly positive in more than 70% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase of at least 0.5% in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals robust supply growth, which typically precedes positive earnings momentum and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are not statistically positive in more than 60% of triggered periods.
